name: Hexagonal Dendrite Crystalliser
promptTemplate: A winter wall of {{crystal_form}} snowflakes crystallising in {{palette}} tones with scale {{crystal_scale}}, floating down at speed {{drift_speed}} under {{wind_sway}} wind sway.

crystal_form.hint: Morphs dendritic branching and plate geometry

palette.hint: Swaps thermal gradient and background vignette

crystal_scale.hint: Size multiplier for subsequent crystal seeds

drift_speed.hint: Downward descent rate across the wall

crystallise.hint: Instantly freeze and release a crystal in your hue

listing.blurb: Snowflakes crystallising with six-fold symmetry from a simple growth model; anyone can start a new flake in their colour, and finished flakes drift down the wall.
listing.prompt: Snowflakes crystallising with six-fold symmetry from a simple growth model; anyone can start a new flake in their colour, and finished flakes drift down the wall. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
